bioconda.name: trace50
bioconda.summary: TRACE-5.0: Dynamic Molecular Surveillance of Viral Transmission Networks
bioconda.description:
TRACE-5.0 deconvolves viral transmission networks from dated nucleotide
alignments. It screens candidate transmission dyads with internal TN93
distances (or a supplied distance matrix), calibrates edges under DANNO
with physical clock-adequacy testing and Bayesian FDR control, resolves
STEVE communities, and infers CHIN macro-scale epidemiological scaling,
emitting a JSON visualization dossier and tabular dyad/community/patient
summaries.
